attchmntText: Wakefit Innovations Limited has informed the Exchange about Link of Recording
voiceSummary: Wakefit Innovations Limited has disclosed that the audio recording of the earnings conference call held on November 13, 2026, is available on its website at www.wakefit.co/investor-relations. The call discussed the unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. This filing is made pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The announcement was issued by Surbhi Sharma, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, with membership number A57349. The company requests that this information be taken on record.

attchmntText: Wakefit Innovations Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Wakefit Innovations Limited filed an investor presentation for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported highest-ever quarterly revenue from operations of INR 4,519.9 mn in Q2 FY27, up 19.9% year-on-year. Half-year revenue reached INR 8,569.0 mn, up 18.4% year-on-year. Operating EBITDA for the quarter was INR 501.5 mn, with an EBITDA margin of 11.1%. Profit before tax increased to INR 265.4 mn, up 66.3% year-on-year. Profit after tax excluding deferred tax stood at INR 223.2 mn, up 39.9% year-on-year. The company crossed 10 million lifetime orders and expanded its COCO store network to 205 stores across 137 cities. MBO stores reached 2,589 across 787 cities. The presentation is available on the company website at www.wakefit.co/investor-relations.

attchmntText: Wakefit Innovations Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 12, 2026, titled "Press release in relation to the unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026".
voiceSummary: Wakefit Innovations Limited filed a press release regarding unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Revenue from operations for Q2 FY27 was INR 4,519.9 mn, up 19.9% year-on-year. Half-year revenue stood at INR 8,569.0 mn, up 18.4%. Reported EBITDA excluding other income for Q2 was INR 501.5 mn, with a margin of 11.1%. Profit after tax for Q2 was INR 158.9 mn. The company crossed 200 company-owned stores, reaching 205 as of September 30, 2026.

attchmntText: Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: Wakefit Innovations Limited submitted the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, issued by CARE Ratings Limited. The report covers the utilization of proceeds from the Pre-IPO Placement aggregating to Rs. 56.00 crore. The monitoring agency confirmed no deviation from the objects of the issue. No funds were utilized during the quarter. The entire unutilized amount of Rs. 56.00 crore is parked in fixed deposits with Axis Bank Limited. The funds are held for general corporate purposes. The report was signed by Himanshu Jain, Associate Director at CARE Ratings Limited.

attchmntText: Wakefit Innovations Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Wakefit Innovations Limited approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board meeting was held on November 12, 2026. Revenue from operations for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, was 4,519.93 million, compared to 4,049.11 million in the previous quarter. Profit before tax for the quarter was 265.44 million, compared to 363.05 million in the previous quarter. Earnings per share for the quarter was 0.48 basic and 0.47 diluted. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations was 8,569.04 million. Profit before tax for the half year was 628.49 million. Earnings per share for the half year was 1.18 basic and 1.18 diluted. The results were reviewed by M/s B S R & Co. LLP. The company completed an initial public offering on December 15, 2025.
